title: House Robber II
summary: Houses form a ring, so the first and last houses are neighbors.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100 values in [0,1000]. A ring with one house permits taking that house.

statement: Houses form a ring, so the first and last houses are neighbors. Find the maximum sum of a selection with no neighboring houses.

examples.explanation: Every pair is adjacent in this ring.

constraints: 1–100 values in [0,1000]. A ring with one house permits taking that house.
hints: Conceptual: The first and last houses cannot both be chosen.
Directional: Split the problem into two line-shaped cases, each excluding one endpoint.
Implementation: Solve both lines with the usual skip-or-take recurrence. Handle the single house separately.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space when scanning ranges.
